title: Rav Yisroel Eliezer Hager Passes
body: Rav Yisroel Eliezer Hager zt”l, Av Beis Din of Seret Vizhnitz in Yerushalayim, passed away at 74. He was born in Haifa to Rav Moshe Hager, Rosh Yeshivas Seret Vizhnitz and mechaber of Birchas Moshe.

title: Chareidi Draft Enforcement Ruling
body: Israel's High Court demands the state take aggressive action against chareidi draft non-compliance, ordering immediate enforcement against those who don't report for the draft.
